Everything LOOKS great, but beware of eye expectations
Aug 2018 • Family
First I would like to mention that the price you pay is determined by when you FINISH eating, not when you start. We got here half an hour before lunch ended and we were charged the dinner price because we ate into dinner time.

From the onset, I came here because it looked fantastic and I really wanted to try it. As it turns out, that was a mistake. Most of the food wasn't fresh, even the food you literally see them bring out. The ingredients are not fresh and the fruit drinks are not fresh, aside from some of the fruits that you have to ask someone to come squeeze for you. All of the preprepared fruit drinks don't even taste like their respective fruits because my cousin said these drinks are from a can. Most of the food was bland, flavorless or tasted really really old. One of the dishes I got was suppose to be tuna but once I bit into it, it turned out to be some kind of white fish which was completely wrong to call it tuna. The sashimi was not fresh, the fried items were not fresh, and the drinks were not fresh. This wouldn't be so bad if it cost five times less but the fact that this buffet costs a whopping 14% the average wage in Vietnam, at 500k, the value is absolutely terrible for the terrible food.

one of the best value buffet ever
Oct 2018 • Friends
D'Maris Buffet D7 Lottemart.

I will keep this in bullet point form and let the pics and vids do the talking.

- place is massive. Head waiter said can do roughly 600 per evening and sit 200 guests.

-500k per head but got 15% discount as table was prebooked.

-hard to find obviously faults. Food were replaced regularly and Korean head chef walking around with his Korean 2IC all evening. Quick service to replace dishes and place was clean. Got a bow from head chef on the way out!

- food were all of reasonable 4* buffet standard. A notch down from Intercontinental, M Gallery or Hotel Nikko but this is a third of the price.

- bonus if you like Korean food.

- far superior value for money compared with most other Buffet I have ever had.

- steak was juicy. I asked for 1minute each side to avoid confusion. Didn't bother with sushi. Just a protein attack.

-not a Buffet fan but this was well worth the visit.

- Other branches may have different standards so do your research.
